dialogue.text: It was quite wonderful, but we arrived later than we expected because of the traffic.
dialogue.translation: Òun dára púpọ̀, ṣùgbọ́n a dẹ́ lọ́wọ́ àwọn àgbẹ́kọ́lẹ̀ wa nítorí ẹ̀tọ́ ọkọ̀.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you stay in a hotel or in a cabin?
dialogue.translation: Ṣe o jọ̀wọ́ ní hotelu tabi ní cabin?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We stayed in a small cabin with an amazing view of the lake.
dialogue.translation: A jọ̀wọ́ ní cabin tuntun kan pẹ̀lú ojú-ọnà àlàáfia ní ọta ìlú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the weather was cloudy, did you still enjoy the experience?
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀ni àwọn ọjọ́ àárọ́nà jẹ́ ìmọ̀lẹ̀, ṣe o fẹ́ràn ìmọ̀lẹ̀ yìí?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we decided to go hiking, and we had a wonderful time, however, the trail was quite steep.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀, a jẹ́kú lọ́wọ́ rìn, àti a gbọ́ àlàáfia, ṣùgbọ́n ọna náà dára púpọ̀.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'm glad you had such a good time. I love to travel to new places too.
dialogue.translation: Mo dúpẹ́ fún àwọn ọjọ́ àárọ́nà tí ẹ̀yin gbọ́. Mo fẹ́ rìn sí àwọn ọna tuntun pẹ̀lú.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.yes: I know. A common mistake is using single plastic bags for everything.
dialogue.translation: Mo mọ. Àyọ̀ àgbọ́n jẹ́ láti ṣe àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That habit can cause a lot of damage to the environment over time.
dialogue.translation: Dájúdájú. Àyọ̀ àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what is the best action we can take to reduce our impact?
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, kini àyọ̀ àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ̀n?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, using a reusable bottle is a simple step. And it's likely to become a habit quickly.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀ ni, àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That makes sense. I'm not against small changes, though. Every little bit helps.
dialogue.translation: Ohun tí ó dára. Èmi kò jẹ́ 'against' àyọ̀ àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ́n àgbọ̀n.

scenario: Discussing a decision you had to make

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I had to choose between two job offers last week.
dialogue.translation: Mo fún àwọn àwẹ́ ọ̀fẹ́ mẹ́ta lọ́wọ́ ọ̀sẹ̀ tó jẹ́ yìí.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a tough decision. What options did you weigh?
dialogue.translation: Èyí jẹ́ àṣẹ́dá ìrẹ́. Àwọn àkọ́yà wo ni o fún ọ̀nà?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I considered the salary and the commute, but the risk of moving to a new city was a big factor.
dialogue.translation: Mo fún ìmọ̀ràn sí owo àti ìdíyà, ṣùgbọ́n ìrànṣẹ́ ìtọ́jú sí ilú tuntun jẹ́ àgbọ́n tó nlá.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Were you certain about the outcome of each option?
dialogue.translation: Ṣe o jẹ́kùnà nínú ẹ̀sẹ̀ àwọn àkọ́yà mọ́?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Not fully, although I knew the salary was higher in the second job.
dialogue.translation: Kò jẹ́ kí o gbọ́, bẹ́ẹ̀ni mo mọ̀ pé owo ni ìtọ́jú ní ọ̀fẹ́ keji.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, what did you finally decide?
dialogue.translation: Ní báyìí, kí ni o ṣe àṣẹ́dá lọ́wọ́?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I chose the first job, rather than the second, due to the shorter commute and better work-life balance.
dialogue.translation: Mo yan ọ̀fẹ́ ọ̀kàn, lọ́wọ́ ọ̀fẹ́ keji, nítorí ìdíyà kùtùkùtù àti ìtọ́jú ìwọ̀-ìtọ́jú dára ju.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've changed my mind about the trip to the beach this weekend.
dialogue.translation: Mo yipada ọkàn mi nínú ìtọ́jú yẹ̀n yìí.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? Why? You seemed so excited about it before.
dialogue.translation: Ṣé? Kín ni? Ẹ ti jẹ́ gbọ́gbọ́n pẹ̀lú yìí lọ́wọ́.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Well, I realized that the weather forecast is bad, and actually, I have a lot of work to do.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀, mo mọ̀ pé àwọn ìtọ́jú ọjọ́-ọjọ́ jẹ́ bẹ́ẹ̀, nítorí náà, mo ní ọ̀nà pupọ̀ lọ́wọ́.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But you had a plan to relax and enjoy the sun!
dialogue.translation: Ṣùgbọ́n ẹ ti ní ọrọ láti jọ́wọ́ àti ṣe àlàáfia!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but I realized that it's not possible to finish my project if I go. Since the deadline is Monday, I need to stay home.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo mọ̀ pé kò lẹ́yìn láti pari mi pàpà. Nítorí náà, ọjọ́ Ìsẹ́gun ni àkókò ìtọ́jú mi, mo fún láti jókòó nílé.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a fact. But you could work in the morning and go later, instead of canceling everything.
dialogue.translation: Òtọ́tọ́ ni. Ṣùgbọ́n ẹ lẹ́yìn láti ṣe àkókò àárọ̀ àti lọ lẹ́yìn, lẹ́yìn náà, kí ẹ má kúrò gbogbo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a good idea, though I need to see if my friend can support me with the ride. Thanks for the advice!
dialogue.translation: Ìtọ́jú tuntun ni. Ṣùgbọ́n mo fún láti rí bí ọ̀rẹ́ mi lẹ́yìn láti jọ́wọ́ mi lọ́wọ́ ìtọ́jú. Ẹ kú àlàáfia!

scenario: Talking about cultural differences
frequency_note: words ranked ~700–1500 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ṣe àti àwọn ọ̀nà, àwọn ìdájọ̀ àti àwọn ìtọ́jú ẹ̀yìn kan.
Ìtọ́jú àgbàgbọ̀ tí a ń ṣe ní ibi kan.

vocabulary.translation: tí ó máa ń jẹ́, àti pé

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I find it interesting how many cultural differences there are between countries.
dialogue.translation: Mo rí àdàkú bí àwọn àwọn àlàgbà àti àwọn àṣẹ tí a ń ṣe ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè pátápátá.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, even something like greeting can be a custom that changes the behavior of people.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀, tóun máa ṣe, bí àwọn àlàgbà tí a ń ṣe ní ibi kan lè ṣe àṣẹ tí ó máa ṣe àwọn ìtọ́jú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For example, in my culture, it's rude to eat with your hands, but in some places it's completely polite.
dialogue.translation: Fún àpẹ̀rẹ̀, ní àwọn àlàgbà mi, àdàkú lọ́wọ́ jẹ́ pẹ̀lú ọwọ́, ṣùgbọ́n ní àwọn ibi kan, àlàgbà lọ́wọ́ jẹ́ pẹ̀lú ọwọ́.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I usually expect people to follow local customs, but I try to respect different ones.
dialogue.translation: Mo tóun máa léra àwọn ènìyàn láti ṣe àṣẹ ilera, ṣùgbọ́n mo ṣe àlàáfia àwọn àṣẹ tuntun.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's good. I think many customs are similar in essence, just expressed differently.
dialogue.translation: Bẹ́ẹ̀, dára. Mo rò pé àwọn àṣẹ púpọ̀ jẹ́ àdàkú ní àkọ́kọ́, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n ń ṣe àwọn ìtọ́jú tuntun.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, the key is to be open and learn about the differences between us.
dialogue.translation: Nígbà náà, àkọ́kọ́ lọ́wọ́ láti jẹ́ àlàgbà àti kọ́ àwọn àlàgbà àti àwọn àlàgbà.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's simple. Just go to the settings app and look for the Wi-Fi option.
dialogue.translation: Òun rọ̀. Ṣe àwọn àtẹ́síwájú àwọn àtẹ́síwájú àwọn àtẹ́síwájú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I see. But I also want to download a new messenger app to message my friends.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's useful, but check the battery first. Downloading can use a lot of energy.
dialogue.translation: Òun dára, ṣùgbọ́n ṣe àyẹ̀wọ̀ ìpàdẹ̀ kí o. Ṣàlọ̀ lè jẹ́ ìpàdẹ̀ púpọ̀.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You're right. And what about the screen? Sometimes it stays on too long.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You can change that in the settings, too. Also, as a user, you should share your location with friends only if you trust them.
dialogue.translation: Òun lè yípadà nínú àwọn àtẹ́síwájú. Àti bí oníṣe, o gbọ́dọ̀ fún àwọn ènìyàn rẹ̀ nígbà tí o bá gbàgbọ́ sí wọn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! Now I feel more comfortable using my device online.
dialogue.translation: Ẹ ku! Lọ́nà mo wà pẹ̀lú ìtọ́jú mi lórí àgbọ́n.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Mo rí. Àdìrẹ́ mi jẹ́kùn pẹ̀lú nínú ọjọ́ àkọ́kọ́, ṣugbọn bí o ba mọ̀ ọ́, ó dára púpọ̀.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Ìtàn yìí dára. Ṣe o rọ̀ pé wọn ní ìtọ́jú ní àwẹ̀rẹ̀ àgbọ́n àgbàgbọ̀ yìí?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe, but it's hard. Although they have good players, they need to improve their defense.
dialogue.translation: Ìgbẹ́yìn, sugbọn ó dára. Bẹ́ẹ̀ni wọn ní àwọn ọkànjọ̀ dára, wọn nílà àgbọ́n àwọn ẹ̀kọ́.
